info.name: Vital Signs AI - Medical Sources (Admin)
info.description:
Admin API of the trusted medical source library (AI backend, `app/medical_sources/`).

**Setup:** log in through the NestJS backend as an **Admin** user, copy `data.token_res.access_token.token`, and paste it into the collection variable `adminToken`. Any other role gets **403**; no token gets **401**.

Set `sourceId` to the source you work on (e.g. `US-AHA-HF-2022`).

**Typical flow:** Add a source (draft) → Change it if needed → Approve with the client's written approval (active) → Deactivate when it should no longer be cited.

Every change is written to `ai.audit_log`. The AI picks up changes within 5 minutes.

request.description:
All sources, sorted by country and id. Every filter is optional; untick the ones you don't need.

- `country`: `US` or `MX`
- `status`: `draft`, `proposed_addition`, `active`, `inactive`, `broken`
- `motor`: `triage`, `visual`, `vitals`
- `topic`: a key from **List topics**

request.description:
Adds a source. It is always saved as **draft**: the AI cannot cite it until **Approve** is called.

**Required:** `id`, `country`, `language`, `organisation`, `title`, `link`, `topics`, `motors`, `patient_label`.

**Optional:** `authors`, `year`, `publication`, `doi`, `evidence_level` (default `clinical_guideline`), `client_decision`, `needs_client_confirmation`, `current_note`, `notes`, `reason` (saved in the audit log).

Rules: `id` starts with the country (`US-...` or `MX-...`) and uses capital letters, digits and dashes; `link` must be `https://`; `topics` must come from **List topics**; `motors` from `triage`, `visual`, `vitals`; `language` `en` or `es`. `status` cannot be sent.

request.description: On an **active** source, changing anything the AI or the patient sees (`link`, `title`, `topics`, `motors`, `patient_label`, `organisation`, `authors`, `year`, `publication`, `doi`, `evidence_level`, `language`) needs the client's written approval of the change in `approval`. Without it the answer is **409**. Changing only `notes` or `current_note` needs no approval.

request.description:
Records the client's written approval and makes the source **active**: the AI may cite it (within 5 minutes).

- `approved_by` (required): who approved, e.g. Jose (Vital Signs LLC)
- `approval_note` (required, at least 5 characters): the approval message, or where it is (email date and subject)
- `approved_at` (optional, `YYYY-MM-DD`): date of the approval; empty = today

409 if the source is already active.
